description: This Java source file contains unit tests for the DelinquencyActionParseAndValidator class within the Fineract project. It verifies the validation and parsing logic for delinquency actions like pause and resume, ensuring correct handling of date overlaps, validation of parameters, and business rules enforcement.

classes.name: DelinquencyActionParseAndValidatorTest
classes.description: This class contains comprehensive unit tests for the DelinquencyActionParseAndValidator, ensuring correct validation logic for pause and resume actions in loan delinquency management, including date overlaps and parameter validation.

methods.name: testParseAndValidationIsOKForPause
methods.description: Tests successful parsing and validation of a pause action with valid start and end dates.

methods.name: testParseAndValidationIsOKForResume
methods.description: Tests successful parsing and validation of a resume action.

methods.name: testPauseBothStartAndEndDateIsOverlappingWithAnActivePause
methods.description: Verifies validation failure when a pause period overlaps with an existing active pause.

methods.name: testPauseStartIsOverlappingWithAnActivePause
methods.description: Checks validation error when the start date of a pause overlaps with an existing pause.

methods.name: testNewPauseEndIsOverlappingWithExistingPause
methods.description: Tests validation failure when the new pause's end date overlaps with an existing pause.

methods.name: testNewPauseIsOverlappingWithExistingPauseBecauseSameDates
methods.description: Ensures validation error when attempting to create a pause with the same dates as an existing pause.

methods.name: testNewPauseIsNotOverlappingBecauseThereWasAResume
methods.description: Verifies that a new pause starting after a resume action does not overlap.

methods.name: testResumeIsNotOverlappingWithAnActivePause
methods.description: Checks that resume action validation fails if it overlaps with an active pause.

methods.name: testValidationErrorWhenDelinquencyActionIsMissing
methods.description: Ensures validation error occurs when the action parameter is missing.

methods.name: testValidationErrorWhenLoanIsNotActive
methods.description: Verifies validation error when the loan is not in ACTIVE status.

methods.name: testValidationErrorResumeShouldHaveNoEndDate
methods.description: Checks that resume actions do not have an end date.

methods.name: testValidationErrorResumeInvalidStartDate
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if resume start date is not the current business date.

methods.name: testValidationErrorResumeOnExistingResumeDate
methods.description: Verifies validation error if a resume action already exists on the same date.

methods.name: testValidationErrorPausePeriodShouldBeAtLeastOneDay
methods.description: Checks that pause periods must be at least one day.

methods.name: testValidationErrorPausePeriodMustNotBeBeforeDisbursement
methods.description: Ensures that pause start date is after the loan's disbursement date.

methods.name: testStartDateOrEndDateIsMissingForPause
methods.description: Verifies validation errors for missing start or end dates in pause actions.

methods.name: testStartDateIsMissingForResume
methods.description: Checks validation error when start date is missing for a resume.

methods.name: testNewPausePeriodStartingOnExistingEndDate
methods.description: Verifies that a new pause starting exactly on an existing end date is valid.

methods.name: testNewPauseEndingOnExistingStartDate
methods.description: Verifies that a pause ending exactly on an existing start date is valid.

methods.name: testNewPausePeriodStartingOnExistingEffectiveEndDate
methods.description: Checks overlapping validation when new pause starts on an existing pause's effective end date.

methods.name: testParseAndValidationIsOKForBackdatedPause
methods.description: Tests validation for a backdated pause action.
